scope: Six repository-audit tooling fixes; no ROM build or publication.

fixes.change: Failed qualification cases and batches exit 1; navigator report APIs remain available.
Enemy scans require motion ownership to point back to the actor; owned zero-HP actors remain observable.
Verify staged checkpoints before promoting the final name; failed writes can retry and listings ignore internal staging.
Prepare archive changes before installation, recover both original files on failure, and retain recovery copies if rollback fails or is interrupted.
Refresh the spectacle lab's copy from the configured current battery on every invocation.
Reject an existing rollback metadata copy that differs from the prior stable metadata.

final_archive_source.detail: Includes a second interruption during rollback; verifies that both original recovery files survive.

validation.private_dependencies: New command regressions import with Keystone, NumPy and Pillow deliberately unavailable.

protected_files.note: Battery hashes are dated observations of the actual configured save, not restore instructions.

limits: CLI tests use mocked duel reports or synthetic door manifests; no emulator was started.
Fault injection uses disposable files and stale-actor tests use synthetic RAM; the actual player save is never a fixture.
No new in-engine traversal, presentation, gameplay feel, hardware timing or perceptual audio qualification.
Abrupt termination can require manual recovery from the retained archive ZIP/index pair.
